notes.title: Update Notes - September 25, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and experiencing our game!

As the product is still in Early Access, there may be some bugs and deficiencies. We welcome your feedback so we can do our best to continuously fix and improve the game content.

For the current version, we have made the following fixes and adjustments:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the main quest "Earn 3000 Cash" was stuck at 0/3000 and could not be completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where experience books took up warehouse capacity but were not counted, which caused the warehouse to show a "not enough storage" message.
[/list]

If you encounter any other issues during gameplay, or have suggestions and feedback, please feel free to join our Discord channel or leave a message in the Steam discussion forum. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Sincerely,
The Development Team

notes.title: Update Notes - July 3, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and experiencing our game!

As the product is still in Early Access, there may be some bugs and deficiencies. We welcome your feedback so we can do our best to continuously fix and improve the game content.

For the current version, we have made the following fixes and adjustments:
[list]
[*] Modified the game's numerical model, significantly increasing the output of money, diamonds, and hospital experience to speed up the game pace.
[*] Adjusted equipment drops from main quests (quests completed in old saves cannot be re-claimed; new completions or new games will grant them).
[*] Added mission status display on the main interface when accepting emergency missions.
[*] Modified the patient treatment time in inpatient clinics to make the game pace more reasonable.
[*] Fixed a bug where dragging clinics under specific circumstances might cause them to stop working.
[*] Fixed some game stability issues.
[/list]

If you encounter any other issues during gameplay, or have suggestions and feedback, please feel free to join our Discord channel or leave a message in the Steam discussion forum. Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: 2025.06.17 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and playing our game!
As the game is still in Early Access, there may still be some bugs and incomplete features. We welcome all feedback and suggestions, and we’ll continue doing our best to improve and polish the game.

The following fixes and adjustments have been made in this update:

Fixed an issue where the white freezer vending machine did not drop resources and could not be collected, which may have caused certain related tasks to be impossible to complete.

If you already own this item, please click on it and select “Recycle” to return it to your inventory, then place it again from the shop for it to work properly.

Newly purchased instances of this item will function normally.

If you encounter any other issues during gameplay or have feedback or suggestions, please feel free to join our Discord or leave a comment in the Steam discussion section. Thank you for your support and understanding!

— The Dev Team

notes.content:

notes.title: 2025.06.15 Second Update | Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Thanks again for your support!
This is our second update today, focusing on improving gameplay stability and fixing several key issues.

🛠️ Update Details:
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare issue where staff or treatment rooms could become unresponsive, potentially causing the game to freeze or halt progress.
[*] Improved resolution compatibility on Steam Deck (please note: the game is not fully optimized for Steam Deck yet — play with caution).
[*] Fixed the in-game language settings panel not displaying correctly in some cases.
[*] Updated decoration placement rules — you can now place decorative items inside treatment rooms.
[*] Added Steam Cloud Save support to sync your game progress across devices.
[/list]

If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions, please join our Discord or leave a message on the Steam discussion board.
Thanks again for playing!

— Dev Team

notes.title: 2025.06.14 Patch Notes | Controls & Staff Drag Adjustments
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for continuing to support our game during Early Access! We're making steady improvements based on your feedback.

🛠️ What's New in This Update:
Added WASD keyboard support for moving the map — smoother navigation for players who prefer keyboard controls;

Adjusted the speed and range of coordinate sliding when manually moving staff — for a more polished dragging experience;

Fixed and optimized various bugs and visual errors — improving performance and overall visual quality.

💬 We want to hear from you!
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to join our Discord or leave a message on the Steam Discussions page.

Thanks again,
— The Dev Team

notes.title: 2025.06.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, thank you so much for purchasing and playing our game. As we are still in Early Access, some bugs and missing features are to be expected. We truly appreciate your support and welcome all feedback to help us improve the game as much as possible.

🛠️ Update Highlights
In this update, we've fixed several known issues and introduced a placeholder for an upcoming feature:

Fixed a bug where patients’ mood values behaved incorrectly, which could cause them to leave the hospital unexpectedly;

Fixed a bug that prevented staff from equipping items properly;

Added a placeholder button for Story Mode, which will be unlocked in a future version;

Corrected several technical issues and visual glitches.

🧪 We Need Your Feedback
If you encounter any other bugs or have suggestions for improvements, please don’t hesitate to join our Discord server or leave a message on the Steam discussion board. Your feedback is extremely valuable to us!

Thanks again for your support,
and we’ll see you in the next update!

— The Dev Team
